# GitHub Copilot instructions — Ada development

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide contract, including the security, privacy, branch, review, and approval gates.

For maintainer interaction, read `.github/skills/maintainer-collaboration.md`. For session re-entry and handover, follow `docs/handover.md` and `.github/skills/project-continuity.md`. Consult other task-specific files under `.github/skills/` and review-role definitions under `.github/agents/` only when relevant.

These documents govern **development work**, not Ada's end-user persona or runtime skills. Do not assume that a Markdown file called a "skill" is automatically discovered or executed.
